title: Club Membership: club access scope, off-peak window, and daily check-in count basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership determines which clubs a member may check in at without an extra charge, the off-peak access window for tiers restricted to it, and how many check-ins per day count toward usage statistics.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Club access scope | Off-peak-only access | Weekday off-peak window | Weekend off-peak window | Fee for a non-home-club or out-of-window visit | Check-ins counted per calendar day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | single club (home club only) | No | not applicable | not applicable | $10.00 | 1 |
| Student Metro Access | all clubs | No | not applicable | not applicable | $0.00 | 1 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | all clubs | Yes | 00:00 to 16:00 | all day | $0.00 | 1 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | all clubs | No | not applicable | not applicable | $0.00 | 1 |
| Premier All-Access | all clubs | No | not applicable | not applicable | $0.00 | 2 |
| Black Card All-Access | all clubs | No | not applicable | not applicable | $0.00 | 2 |
| Founding Legacy Access | all clubs | No | not applicable | not applicable | $0.00 | 2 |

## Rule
A member whose tier's club access scope is single club, checking in at a club other than their own designated home club, is charged that tier's own listed fee shown above for that visit. A member whose tier's club access scope is all clubs may check in at any club at no extra charge. A member whose tier restricts access to off-peak hours only, checking in outside that tier's own off-peak window shown above, is not refused entry, but the visit is not covered by the membership and must be handled as a walk-in charged at that tier's own listed fee shown above. Only the tier's own daily check-in count shown above, of the check-ins recorded for that member on a given calendar day, counts toward usage statistics; any further same-day check-ins beyond that count are still logged but are not double-counted toward usage statistics.

## Points of judgement
An Off-Peak Metro Access member checking in on a weekday at 17:00 is checking in outside that tier's own weekday off-peak window (which ends at 16:00), so the visit is handled as a walk-in charged at the listed fee, even though the member is not refused entry. The same member checking in at any time on a weekend day falls within that tier's own all-day weekend off-peak window and is not handled as a walk-in on that basis.
